notes.title: RIN: The Last Child Patch 1.2 is available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42263449/0f6cc6ebda919a59659f35779c4e9caf466835bf.png[/img]

Hello!

Thanks for bearing with us for the last week! Your feedback has been an invaluable help and allowed us to quickly add some elements that you've missed in RIN's gameplay. Let's take a look at all of the changes of Version 1.2:

[h2]Version 1.2 Patchnotes:[/h2]

[h3]Map:[/h3]
[list]
[*] added markers to the world map
[*] added fast travel portals to the world map
[*] updated map legend 
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
[list]
[*] the Phantom Blades spell can now destroy vines with hanging stones
[*] adjusted [redacted] Boss' attacks
[/list]

[h2]Other small fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixed the rune multiplication bug 
[*] added minor localization fixes
[/list]

Thank you once again for your feedback! With all of the messages we've received during last week, we were able to prepare all of those changes and add community desired features to the game. 

Stay awesome and enjoy playing [i][b]RIN: The Last Child![/b][/i]

notes.title: RIN: The Last Child - Patch 1.1 is live
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42263449/e227df16b61336071f839ff39da7d493ed1cc677.png[/img]

Hello!

Thank you for supporting us during launch! We’re glad you enjoy our game and share so many ideas and meaningful feedback regarding the title!

We’ve received remarks about the game's performance or bugged in-game mechanics. We began fixing those issues almost immediately upon notification in order to get rid of them as soon as possible. Below you can find the list of elements that have been fixed with the first patch. 

[h2]Version 1.1 Patchnotes:[/h2]

[h3]Controls:[/h3]
[list]
[*] key binding – fixed an issue that prevented key rebinding
[*] DualShock controller - fixed an issue with DualShock controllers
[*] Xbox controller - fixed an issue with game not recognizing Xbox controllers
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
[list]
[*] adjusted camera work near [redacted]
[*] fixed an issue that made the wall jump impossible in certain areas
[*] fixed problem that caused sudden FPS drops
[*] fixed problem with loading screen
[*] made adjustments to the world map in order to make it more transparent
[/list]
[h3]Other small fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] falling rocks are crumbling once they hit the ground
[*] fixed the lake that bugged falling rocks
[*] unified the name of the last boss
[/list]
 We’re already working on another update, this time focusing on gameplay’s transparency. We’ve heard that some of you miss a sense of goal while moving around the levels. Our plan is to upgrade the map and add objective markers to make it easier to read and plan your gameplay ahead. 

Thank you for your endless support! Please, keep sharing your thoughts and ideas with us – [i][b]RIN: The Last Child[/b][/i] is a game made with you, our great community, in mind, so we want to make it as enjoyable for you as possible.

notes.title: RIN: The Last Child Release Date Delayed
notes.notes:
We have some important news to share regarding the release of RIN: The Last Child across all platforms, including Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch.

Originally, we aimed to bring RIN: The Last Child to all platforms simultaneously on September 21st to deliver the ultimate gaming experience. However, game development, especially for multiple platforms, is a complex journey filled with unexpected challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42263449/b4cbfc208b8705845ecf03e29c016ae1ea65a434.jpg[/img]

[h2]Release Date Delayed to Q4 2023[/h2]
We are committed to delivering an unforgettable adventure to you across all platforms at once. Unfortunately, we have encountered some issues during the certification process on consoles. Licensing process with Microsoft Corporation has been delayed, and we had to make a tough decision - to postpone the game’s release to [b]Q4 2023[/b].

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
We would love to share the exact release date, and we are working tirelessly to resolve the ongoing issues. We will keep you updated and will unveil the new release date as soon as possible, so please stay tuned.

Thank you for being a part of our magical community. Your patience and support mean the world to us. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1960070/RIN_The_Last_Child/

notes.title: Drawing Near the Finish: Rin’s Development Update
notes.notes:
Greetings from the trenches! We may have been quiet, but we've been anything but idle - we're working our way towards a happy conclusion ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42263449/b4cbfc208b8705845ecf03e29c016ae1ea65a434.jpg[/img]

Time has flown since our last update! Rest assured, we're still here and busier than ever, immersing ourselves in the most critical phase of game development - [b]finalizing the game[/b]. You're probably wondering, [i]"What's been going on?"[/i] Allow us to shed some light!

[list]
[*] Polish, Polish, Polish! Yes, indeed, we've been giving Rin the love she deserves in terms of game balance, level art, and addressing other nuances typically reserved for the end of the production pipeline.
[*] In-depth testing. Our dedicated testers have been working tirelessly to ensure we uncover and address every single bug.
[*] Bug fixes. As gamers ourselves, we understand how frustrating it can be to dive into a game that feels half-baked, which is why we're committed to delivering Rin at her very best.
[/list]

But hold on, there's more good news on the horizon! However, we must keep you in suspense a little longer. Stay tuned, as we'll soon be sharing more exciting updates!
